title: World Classics Seed

concurrency.acceleration: When review quality is stable, run `npm run concurrency -- --set world-classics-seed --multiply 10`. When account limits or quality failures hit, run with `--reset`.

sourcePolicy: Each planned chunk covers 0.01% to 0.1% of a source work. Workers may snap boundaries to the nearest book, chapter, paragraph, line, couplet, or scene boundary during generation, but the manifest retains percentage coverage for coordination.
